name: FAQ — Listwell
html:
Frequently asked questions

Can I use Listwell for free?

Yes. The Free plan includes unlimited personal lists, reminders, and one shared list, on every device, for as long as you use it.

Does Listwell work offline?

Every app keeps a local copy of your lists, so you can check off tasks with no signal and everything syncs the moment you're back online.

Can I move my lists from another app?

Import from most common formats in a couple of minutes. Your lists, tags, and due dates come across as-is.

How does team billing work?

Team plans are billed per member, monthly or yearly. Add or remove people at any time and your bill adjusts on the next cycle.

Is my data private?

Your lists belong to you. We never sell data or show ads, and team admins control exactly who can see a shared list.
